email.body:
When customer feedback sits inside a call transcript, support ticket or review, the useful unit for a product decision is the feature request—not the entire conversation.

Canny is customer feedback management software. Autopilot reads those sources, pulls out individual feature requests and merges detected duplicates.

It also triages the resulting feedback to the right team, so product can work from a request instead of only a link back to the full source.

Autopilot is included in every Canny plan. The Free plan is $0/month, billed yearly, and includes up to 25 tracked users, so you can evaluate whether this workflow fits your team.
